answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the mirror of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
